meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成支持备注和跳转的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常要把资料整理成可演示的幻灯片
copy.tagline_en: Turn your content into a presentation deck with speaker notes and branching.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn rough notes into a navigable slide deck for presenting.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，当你要做演示或幻灯片时，Claude会生成一个HyperFrames幻灯片——由多张幻灯片组成的可交互演示，支持翻页、局部展示、点击跳转和演讲者备注；它也能把现有网页转成这种幻灯片。输出是能直接播放的演示，不是视频文件。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做幻灯片、幻灯片放映或HyperFrames幻灯片时触发；如果只是提到“演示”、“投资推介”等，或要求转换现有页面，Claude会先确认。

howto.what_en: With this skill, on a slideshow request Claude creates a HyperFrames slideshow — a navigable deck with slide fragments, hotspot branching, and presenter notes — and can convert an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not an MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user explicitly asks for a slideshow, slide show, or HyperFrames slideshow. For adjacent asks like 'presentation', 'pitch deck', or 'convert this page', Claude confirms first.
